Staff Software Engineer
United States
Opportunity Overview: 
 We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to join our Engineering department. In this role, you will direct a fast-paced, collaborative, agile team of software engineers in the design, development, and scaling of highly available AI healthcare products on the Cohere platform. You'll set the technical direction for how the platform evolves — owning architecture and design decisions that span multiple teams and outlive any single release. This is an opportunity to drive technical excellence, define customer-configurability capabilities, and establish patterns other teams build on at the intersection of healthcare interoperability and modern distributed systems.
 This is a remote-first role that may require travel to Boston, MA for new hire onboarding and occasional in-person team meetings and company events.
 What you’ll do: 
 Technical Leadership: Provide technical leadership across architecture, system design, and mentor junior engineers for building scalable SaaS products.
 Platform Ownership: Lead the development and enhancement of Cohere’s AI-powered applications and platforms, ensuring that it is highly configurable, and optimized for performance.
 Data & Retrieval Architecture: Design data and retrieval architectures that give AI agents the right context, across diverse healthcare sources.
 Hands-On Engineering: Design, review, and own high-quality production code — actively contributing alongside the team, leading releases, production deployments, reducing developer development friction and on-call support.
 NFR, Security & Compliance: Drive technical strategy to ensure the team's designs consistently address non-functional requirements — observability, instrumentation, performance, and operational readiness that incorporate security and privacy regulations 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with ML/DS teams, product teams, and architects to understand requirements and ensure systems meet business needs.
 Agile Development: Contribute to sprint planning, execution, and retrospectives, driving efficiency and velocity within the engineering team and collaborating closely with stakeholders to align with product goals and business priorities.
 What you’ll need: 
 12+ years in the software development lifecycle, with progression to complex, high-impact cloud-native system design
 Expertise in auth/authz frameworks, secure API design, access control, and automated testing
 Strong system design, observability, and production operations skills
 Fullstack expertise in modern languages, event-driven systems, and CI/CD; IaC a plus
 Experience designing data systems/pipelines for analytical and AI workloads, with strong data modeling fundamentals
 Track record shaping engineering standards, mentoring engineers, and communicating strategy across technical and non-technical audiences
 AI architectures (multi-agent, RAG, evaluation frameworks) a plus
 Healthcare tech, health plan, or Payment Integrity experience a plus; Healthcare interoperability standards and clinical ontologies a plus
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
 Pay & Perks: 
 💻 Fully remote opportunity with about 5% travel
 🩺 Medical, dental, vision, life, disability insurance, and Employee Assistance Program 
 📈 401K retirement plan with company match; flexible spending and health savings account 
 🏝️ Flex Time Off + company holidays
 👶 Up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave 
 🐶 Pet insurance  
 The salary range for this position is $185,000 to $225,000 annually; as part of a total benefits package which includes health insurance, 401k and bonus. In accordance with state applicable laws, Cohere is required to provide a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. Individual pay decisions are ultimately based on a number of factors, including but not limited to qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and internal alignment. 
 Interview Process*: 
 Connect with Talent Acquisition for a Preliminary Phone Screening
 Meet your Hiring Manager!
 Live System Design 
 Project Discussion 
 Cross Functional Interview 
 *Subject to change
 About Cohere Health: 
 Cohere Health’s clinical intelligence platform and agentic AI-powered solutions connect health plans’ strategic goals and providers’ needs, optimizing the speed, cost, and quality of care. With an enterprise approach that streamlines payer-provider decision-making across the care continuum–including policy, prior authorization, payment accuracy, and more–the company improves collaboration and reduces burden, resulting in up to 8x ROI and 94% provider satisfaction. 
 With the acquisition of ZignaAI, we’ve further enhanced our platform by launching our Payment Integrity Suite, anchored by Cohere Validate™, an AI-driven clinical and coding validation solution that operates in near real-time. By unifying pre-service authorization data with post-service claims validation, we’re creating a transparent healthcare ecosystem that reduces waste, improves payer-provider collaboration and patient outcomes, and ensures providers are paid promptly and accurately.
 Cohere Health’s innovations continue to receive industry wide recognition. We’ve been named to the 2025 Inc. 5000 list and in the Gartner® Hype Cycle™ for U.S. Healthcare Payers (2022-2025), and ranked as a Top 5 LinkedIn™ Startup for 2023 & 2024. Backed by leading investors such as Deerfield Management, Define Ventures, Flare Capital Partners, Longitude Capital, and Polaris Partners. 
 The Coherenauts, as we call ourselves, who succeed here are empathetic teammates who are candid, kind, caring, and embody our core values and principles . We believe that diverse, inclusive teams make the most impactful work. Cohere is deeply invested in ensuring that we have a supportive, growth-oriented environment that works for everyone.
 We can’t wait to learn more about you and meet you at Cohere Health! 
 Equal Opportunity Statement: 
 Cohere Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all. To us, it’s personal.
